lessons.title: A rapid rise to the top flight
lessons.subtitle: From its 1899 beginnings to a Bundesliga promotion in 2008, Hoffenheim climbed the divisions in a generation.

story.title: A village club takes shape
story.body: TSG Hoffenheim began in 1899 as a gymnastics club in the district of Hoffenheim. Football came later, and the club spent much of its early history far below Germany’s top divisions.

story.title: Promotions transform the club
story.body: After local investor Dietmar Hopp began supporting the team in 1989, Hoffenheim rose through the divisions. It reached the Bundesliga in 2008 after back-to-back promotions from the third tier and second division.

facts.prompt: In what year was TSG Hoffenheim created as a gymnastics club?
facts.scope: TSG Hoffenheim’s club history
facts.evidence: The Bundesliga historical guide says Hoffenheim was created as a gymnastics club in 1899.

facts.prompt: In which year did Hoffenheim first reach the Bundesliga?
facts.scope: TSG Hoffenheim’s rise to the Bundesliga
facts.evidence: The Bundesliga historical guide dates Hoffenheim’s promotion to the top flight to 2008.

facts.scope: Hoffenheim’s 2008/09 Bundesliga debut season
facts.evidence: The historical guide states that Hoffenheim sat top of the Bundesliga at the midpoint of its maiden season.

lessons.title: Hoffenheim’s first win over Bayern
lessons.subtitle: A 2017 victory over the reigning champions became the club’s first Bundesliga win against Bayern Munich.

story.title: An upset against the champions
story.body: On 4 April 2017, Hoffenheim hosted league leaders Bayern Munich in a top-of-the-table Bundesliga match. Andrej Kramarić scored the only goal, giving Hoffenheim its first-ever Bundesliga victory over Bayern.

story.title: A landmark result
story.body: Kramarić struck in the 21st minute. Bayern pressed for an equaliser after the break, but Hoffenheim held on to win 1–0.

facts.label: Match date
facts.prompt: On what date did Hoffenheim earn its first Bundesliga victory over Bayern Munich?
facts.scope: Hoffenheim’s first Bundesliga win over Bayern Munich
facts.evidence: FC Bayern’s match report dates Hoffenheim’s 1–0 victory to 4 April 2017.

facts.label: Final score
facts.prompt: What was the score when Hoffenheim recorded its first Bundesliga win over Bayern Munich?
facts.scope: Hoffenheim’s first Bundesliga win over Bayern Munich
facts.evidence: FC Bayern’s report gives the result as Hoffenheim 1–0 Bayern Munich.

facts.label: Winning goal
facts.prompt: Who scored Hoffenheim’s winning goal against Bayern Munich on 4 April 2017?
facts.scope: Hoffenheim’s first Bundesliga win over Bayern Munich
facts.evidence: FC Bayern’s match report identifies Andrej Kramarić as the 21st-minute scorer.

lessons.title: Survival in the 2013 play-off
lessons.subtitle: Hoffenheim kept its Bundesliga place by beating Kaiserslautern 5–2 across two legs in 2013.

story.title: A season on the line
story.body: Hoffenheim finished 16th in the 2012/13 Bundesliga and faced Bundesliga 2 side Kaiserslautern in the two-legged relegation play-off. A 3–1 first-leg win gave Hoffenheim a cushion.

story.title: One more year in the top flight
story.body: Hoffenheim also won the return leg, 2–1 away at Kaiserslautern. The 5–2 aggregate victory retained Hoffenheim’s Bundesliga status.

facts.prompt: Which club did Hoffenheim face in the 2012/13 Bundesliga relegation play-off?
facts.scope: 2012/13 Bundesliga relegation play-off

facts.evidence: The league’s results table records the tie as 5–2 on aggregate (3–1, 1–2).

facts.label: Return-leg score

facts.scope: 2012/13 Bundesliga relegation play-off, second leg
facts.evidence: The Bundesliga table gives Hoffenheim 5–2 on aggregate, with a 3–1 home first leg and a 1–2 away return leg. Both legs were Hoffenheim wins.

lessons.title: A loan that became a long stay
lessons.subtitle: Kramarić arrived in January 2016, scored five times in his first 15 Hoffenheim appearances, and earned a permanent move.

story.title: A January arrival
story.body: Hoffenheim brought Kramarić from Leicester City on loan on January 20, 2016. The Croatian striker was 24 and needed a quick impact as the club fought to stay in the Bundesliga.

story.title: A permanent place
story.body: Five goals in his first 15 appearances helped the club remain in the top flight and convinced Hoffenheim to sign him permanently.

lessons.title: Three before half-time
lessons.subtitle: Kramarić scored a first-half hat-trick in Hoffenheim’s 5–1 win over Gladbach on January 14, 2026.

story.title: A first-half treble
story.body: On Bundesliga Matchday 17 in January 2026, Kramarić scored three times before half-time against Borussia Mönchengladbach. His penalty opened the scoring, followed by two finishes in first-half stoppage time.

story.title: A five-goal home win
story.body: Hoffenheim went on to win 5–1. The hat-trick formed part of a commanding home performance and gave Kramarić a milestone to mark ten years with the club.

facts.evidence: The official match report gives a 5–1 Hoffenheim victory.

facts.evidence: The Bundesliga match report describes his treble as a first-half hat-trick, with goals at 22, 45+1 and 45+4 minutes.

story.title: A prolific season
story.body: In 2017/18, Kramarić scored 13 Bundesliga goals as Hoffenheim finished third and entered Champions League qualification. In 2020/21, he reached his best league season output with 20 goals.

story.title: Four at Dortmund
story.body: On the final day of 2019/20, Kramarić scored all four goals in Hoffenheim’s 4–0 win at Borussia Dortmund.

story.body: Süle made his Bundesliga debut for Hoffenheim in May 2013. He became a regular over the next four seasons, appearing 108 times for the club in the league.

story.title: Europe’s top prize

lessons.title: The 1968 FDGB-Pokal triumph
lessons.subtitle: Union overturned a first-minute deficit to beat East German champions Carl Zeiss Jena 2–1.

story.title: A cup run in East Germany
story.body: In the 1967/68 FDGB-Pokal, Union defeated defending cup holders Sachsenring Zwickau in the quarterfinal and city rivals Vorwärts Berlin in the semifinal.

story.title: A comeback in Halle
story.body: Carl Zeiss Jena led after about 30 seconds in the final. Meinhard Uentz equalised from the spot, and Ralf Quest scored the 63rd-minute winner.

lessons.title: A place in the top flight
lessons.subtitle: A 0–0 draw with Stuttgart on May 27, 2019, sent Union to its first Bundesliga season.

story.title: A tense second leg
story.body: After a 2–2 draw in Stuttgart, Union hosted the playoff return leg. The match remained goalless, and the aggregate score stayed level.

story.title: Away goals decide
story.body: Union advanced on the away-goals rule, earning its first-ever promotion to the Bundesliga after 90 minutes plus stoppage time.

facts.evidence: Union’s report gives the second leg as a 0–0 draw.

facts.scope: Union vs VfB Stuttgart, 2019 Bundesliga promotion playoff second leg
facts.evidence: The club report says Union advanced on away goals after a 2–2 first leg and 0–0 second leg.

lessons.title: A first Bundesliga victory
lessons.subtitle: Union beat Borussia Dortmund 3–1 on August 31, 2019, for its first Bundesliga win.

story.title: A famous home night
story.body: On Matchday 3 of 2019/20, Union faced title contenders Borussia Dortmund at the Alte Försterei. Paco Alcácer equalised after Marius Bülter’s opener.

story.title: A landmark result
story.body: Bülter scored again after half-time and Sebastian Andersson added a third. Union secured its first Bundesliga victory, 3–1.

facts.label: Match date

facts.scope: Union vs Borussia Dortmund, Bundesliga, August 31, 2019
facts.evidence: The official match center dates the win to August 31, 2019.

facts.scope: Union vs Borussia Dortmund, Bundesliga, August 31, 2019

story.title: A proven Bundesliga forward
story.body: At the time of the move, Union’s announcement credited him with 74 goals in 250 Bundesliga matches and four goals in 14 Germany appearances.

lessons.title: A stoppage-time European ticket

story.title: A final-day challenge
story.body: Union needed a result against second-place Leipzig on the final day of 2020/21. Marvin Friedrich equalised after Justin Kluivert had put Leipzig ahead.

story.title: The decisive header
story.body: In the second minute of stoppage time, Sheraldo Becker crossed for Kruse to head home the 2–1 winner and secure Union’s place in the next season’s European Conference League.
